import requests
import re

@app.route('/vulnerable_api', methods=['POST'])
def vulnerable_api():
    user_input = request.json.get('user_input')

    # Validate input
    if not user_input:
        abort(400, description="user_input is required")
    
    # Example validation: Ensure user_input is a valid alphanumeric string
    if not isinstance(user_input, str) or not re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$', user_input):
        abort(400, description="Invalid user_input format")

    # Sanitize input
    sanitized_input = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]', '', user_input)

    # Use parameterized URL construction to avoid injection issues
    url = f'https://external.api.com/data/{sanitized_input}'
    response = requests.get(url)

    # Handle response errors
    if response.status_code != 200:
        abort(response.status_code, description="External API request failed")

    return jsonify(response.json()), 200
